name: Moonstalker Matriarch has two persistent runts before combat (#4348)
contract: The report describes two runts already present before their matriarch enters combat. Observe native spawn-
time SmartAI from outside aggro range, without injecting a summon. The two runts must survive longer than
the old 30-second combat-summon lifetime; entering combat must not create a third. Killing the matriarch
must preserve the owner-specific cleanup added for #4347. The summoned runts are level 16-17, as reported
in upstream issue 8795 and supported by summon spell 8594's -3 level value. Both must wander from their
spawn positions; the 10-yard radius comes from existing wild Moonstalker Runt spawn data. Use the real
Darkshore Matriarch spawn 36967 as the mother's position, with the observer 30 yards west, so wandering
runs on terrain and navigation data that support these ground creatures.
The fixture creator places the mother at the observer's initial Z. After creating that mother at the
real spawn height, teleport only the observer to its local ground height, 28.1901, and verify both the
native terrain height and observer Z. This keeps the observer in melee reach when the mother chases it.

steps.label: Place the observer on the ground without moving the mother or runts
The observer position has the expected native terrain height
The observer stands at ground level for native melee
Exactly two runts exist before combat
Both summoned runts have the reported level
Both runts move away from their own spawn positions before combat
The pre-spawned runts do not expire after 30 seconds
Entering combat does not summon an additional runt
Both pre-spawned runts leave with their matriarch
